description: Browse fused.catalog collections, preview one on a map over time and copy the code that reads it

catalog.description: The fused.catalog reader whose collections show first: "imagery". Defaults to "imagery".

collection.description: A collection to open on load, by id (e.g. "hls2-s30"). Accepts a $param reference. Omit it to start on the list of collections.

param.description: Canvas parameter the widget writes with what the open collection shows: { collection, bounds: [west, south, east, north], time: "start/end" or null, bands: [...], mask_clouds }. A UDF downstream can pass it to fused.catalog.imagery.

style.description: CSS string for the outer element.

propsSchema.description:
Browses the datasets fused.catalog serves and previews one. The list shows every collection with a thumbnail, its resolution, time range and bands, by category and search. Opening a collection draws its pixels over the map view straight from the reader (no UDF runs), steps through the scenes of a date range on a time bar with the band's mean over time, and gives the UDF code that reads the same area, dates and bands, ready to copy.

## Example

```json
{ "type": "data-catalog", "props": { "style": "height: 720px" } }
```

Open one collection and share what it shows:

```json
{ "type": "data-catalog", "props": { "collection": "hls2-s30", "param": "imagery" } }
```
